decision.summary: No new action: the daily 78k reach remains the correct live trade, and there is still no justified second position or management trigger.
decision.rationale: Binance remains bullish short term with expanding open interest and price still pressing toward the session highs, so the existing 78k reach daily remains the right live expression of the corrective rebound thesis. The position is not near take-profit and not near exceptional invalidation. Re-adding is not allowed because it already uses the full early-stage $1 live cash cap. The next bullish daily at 79k is too weak around 9.5%, while bearish dailies and weekly dips remain completely out of sync with current execution reality. Best move is to hold the existing daily and avoid forcing anything else.
